title: Paths generated by a leaf
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha$ be a type of output labels, and let a leaf of a binary decision tree return a value $a\in\alpha$ without querying any coordinate. The list of paths generated by this leaf consists of the single path that specifies no coordinates and has output $a$.
hypotheses_covered: The leaf's output is a value in $\alpha$
The leaf is indexed by an available set of coordinates
